notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Merfolk.
description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven Merfolk you control, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
The Merfolk token enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
